incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 alert — spike in 5xx rates (gateway + timeouts) across api-gateway-prod. Auto-page to #incidents and paging oncall. Monitoring shows 5xx rate jump ~3.6% -> 18% since 14:02 UTC.

alex (sre-oncall): on it, ACK. pulling traces now. anyone see recent deploys?

maria (eng-platform): no deploys to gateway in last 30m from the deploy-bot. but quota-service config was rolled 14:00 by jamie.

jamie (runtime): i pushed a quota policy change (reduce burst window) to reduce noisy tenants, rolled at 14:00. thinking: could be overrestricting token buckets and causing backpressure into upstream gateways -> 5xx.

ben (support): i'm seeing customer reports for timeouts and 429s then 502s. customers: two mid-market pods experiencing highest errors.

charlie (prod-eng): timeline fits. quota-service returns 429 -> gateway retries -> connection saturates -> internal 502/504. need to check rate-limiter logs.

alex (sre-oncall): good call. start mitigation: 1) revert quota-policy to previous snapshot, 2) open bypass for high-error routes, 3) enable degraded fallback model for heavy tenants. i'm assigning actions.

jamie (runtime): grabbing the policy snapshot now. current config hash: `sha256:fa3b9c`. previous snapshot available at `policy/2026-03-14/13-50`.

jamie (runtime): rolling back policy now — running:
```
kubectl -n infra exec deploy/quota-service -- curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/policies/rollback --data '{"snapshot":"policy/2026-03-14/13-50"}'
```

deploy-bot: rollback job accepted, job id 98231, starting rollout.

alex (sre-oncall): while rollback runs, open a temporary traffic rule to stop gateway from retrying on 429s to avoid cascade. patching gateway config: set `max_retries_on_4xx=0` for affected routes.

maria (eng-platform): applying gateway patch (hot config):
```
PATCH /v1/admin/routes/patch
{"route":"/v1/generate","max_retries_on_4xx":0}
```

maria (eng-platform): applied to 4 edge nodes, propagating.

ben (support): reported 429s dropping, customers reporting immediate improvement in requests that previously turned into timeouts. still seeing some 502s.

jamie (runtime): rollback completed on quota-service across all replicas — policy back to previous snapshot. verified returned 200.

charlie (prod-eng): checking quota-service logs: before rollback a single tenant A was hitting extremely aggressive backoff causing token queue growth. after rollback, token buckets are stable.

alex (sre-oncall): good. next: remove retry suppression after stability window and plan lower-impact mitigation: tune quota burst for offending tenant(s) and add explicit fallback pipeline. create follow-up ticket.

alex (sre-oncall): immediate mitigation summary for postmortem: 1) reverted quota policy 14:07 (jamie) 2) disabled 4xx->retry behavior on gateway 14:05 (maria) 3) temporarily routed heavy tenants to degraded model 14:06 (charlie) 4) support notified impacted customers 14:08 (ben).

ben (support): notified customer success + sent status to affected customers: "we rolled back a recent quota update and implemented temporary routing to reduce timeouts. monitoring ongoing."

maria (eng-platform): metrics: 5xx peaked at 18% at 14:03, fell to 2.1% by 14:10. 429s dropped from 7% to 1.3%.

alex (sre-oncall): good. capturing action items:
- jamie: create safe rollout plan for quota-policy changes; include canary + gradual ramp + synthetic checks (ETA: EOD).
- charlie: implement tenant-level isolation to avoid single-tenant token exhaustion (ETA: 2w).
- maria: add circuit-breaker in gateway for 4xx-origin to avoid retry storms (ETA: 1w).
- ben: follow up with customers and log incident messages (ETA: 1h).

jamie (runtime): noted. will add automated smoke tests that exercise quota semantics before policy rollouts.

alex (sre-oncall): marking monitor: `api-gateway-prod` stable at 14:12, keeping this thread open for 1 hour for monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1755, severity SEV-2, primary oncall alex, channel #incidents.

ben (support): closing customer tickets with note: root cause suspected quota policy misconfiguration; mitigation applied; follow-up planned.

charlie (prod-eng): also adding a quick dashboard widget to show 4xx->retry conversion rate so we can alert earlier.

alex (sre-oncall): handing off to maria for monitoring and postmortem writeup. i'm going to get off-call. @maria please own the postmortem and timeline. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

maria (eng-platform): taking postmortem ownership. will draft timeline and action items, link to incident ticket INC-2026-1755 and assign follow-ups.

deploy-bot: deployment log: quota policy rollback job 98231 completed successfully at 14:07 UTC.

alex (sre-oncall): last check: 5xx < 1% for 5m sliding window, closing page. if it resurfaces, re-open and page oncall.

maria (eng-platform): noted. switching to watch mode. thanks all. :heart:
